name: Holiday Inn & Suites Jakarta Gajah Mada By IHG
detail: After a few dodgy 4* hotels in Jakarta booked previously, this one is definitely my favourite. Staff was great and attentive, my room was spacious and ultra clean, food in the restaurant was superb, I really cannot complain. Loved it.

name: Townhouse Oak Ancol
detail: Comfortably stay and the staff were friendly too.

name: Super OYO Townhouse OAK Hotel Fiducia Pondok Gede
detail: Really value for money, worth it dengan harga segitu

name: Classic Hotel
detail: Wonderful hotel with best hospitality. Including all the entertainments. Rooms were clean. Very friendly staff. Many clubs inside the hotel premises. Many spas too. Beautiful dancing ladies and live DJ events everyday. Massive hotel all together. Very tasty breakfast too. This hotel is the best hotel in Jakarta. 10 out of 10.

name: Cool Living
detail: Minimalis and cozy place. The location is great, nice place for solo or couple. Not suitable for family with young children since the room/space is small.

name: ARTOTEL Thamrin Jakarta
detail: I've stayed twice at Atotel. When I was looking for hotels I came across this hotel, hmm.. Interesting concept. I booked & I have not regretted choosing Artotel. When I entered Artotel I was like WOW! The smell was so fresh & nice. I luv the deco. I myself luv arts. I think it's really great they came up with this getting few artist to paint in the rooms..thruout the hotel. I was telling myself I wished Malaysia had something like this. The food.. I had breakfast & it wasn't that great. I think they need to improve. I ordered the room service chicken wings...that was nice. There are times I'm sure some guest who are so tired would like to stay in their room, order room service, relax... Laundry..I snd my white blouse & few others for a wash.. My white blouse came back in light baby blue color & it wasn't iron properly & same as the rest too... I told d staff about it & they apologise.. Most hotels I've stayed when I ask for iron they give me the usual normal iron but at Artotel it's steam iron. I prefer steam iron as it's easier for me. At Artotel they think of everything they could to make it easier for their guest. In Indonesia their plug is different than Malaysia or in England so they made sure they had that install so the guest don't really need to buy an adapter. You can't expect everything to be perfect at all the hotels, even at a 5 or 6 star hotels you get some faulty too. Sometime things do happen. Besides that I really do like Artotel. It's one of my favourite hotel in Jakarta. I would definitely stay at Artotel again & I highly recommend this hotel to anyone.

name: Mercure Jakarta Batavia
detail: We felt like renaissance elite. This hotel has it all to take you down in history. Large ballroom and everything. We paid a promo price and for that we got a very luxerious tay, al though it seemed abandoned at times, large spooky hallways, which was actually kind of fun. Rooms are very luxerious. Go to this hotel for the historic feel, don't expect an actual four star hotel, expect an experiance. For us the only place possible to stay in Jakarta Kota

name: Wonderloft Hostel Kota Tua
detail: I have traveled Asia for close to two years now, and I have yet to find a place that meets all of my expectations--this one nailed them, all of them. The common area(s)--which are a big deal for me--were so cozy and filled with energy. The first common area is downstairs and is where everybody hangs out. It is where you can make dozens of friends and learn all about Indonesia very quickly--it is also where the pool table and big screen TV is (which is loaded with new movies!) The other sits upstairs, unbothered by noise and traffic. The choice is yours at any given moment. I occupied both in equal respects of time. The showers were hot, and although the water is not treated, I did not really care--you may though. The wifi was the best I have ever used. It was so fast that I could stream videos uninterrupted from anywhere in the building. The dorm was comfortable, but keep in mind that it is a dorm and not a private room: the noise will always be there. If you are going to pass through Jakarta, stay here. The staff can answer any question you have and help you make it through Java, Bali, and Lombok!

name: Konko Hostel
detail: My first time of hostel experience in Indonesia. This is a brand new hostel, location is quite good in the very central, close to all big shopping malls and restaurants. Staff can speak good English and are also friendly, overall worth of the money I spent! Pros: cheap, location, thoughtful touches( you can buy toothpaste, rent tower all at cheap price), choice of ensuit bathroom room which is super for girls! Strong enough AC, ok standard mattress, friendly staff, next door is a restaurant. Cons: not as clean as I expected. This part I think the management need to improve the maintenance. They didn’t do cleaning per day, once I found lipstick stain on the duvet cover as well as unknown stain on the bed sheet. Hair in the bathroom since day I checked in till 3 nites after. Room is not spacious enough (however the bathroom is quite big), perhaps a 26inch suitcase will not fit in the room. There’s no 3 beds of room type here which still listed on agoda. However it’s still a nice place for solo travelers who would like to try hostel in jkt or with budget. I would stay again which I’ve extended 2 more nights right after!

name: Gran Mahakam Hotel
detail: Rooms are a bit small, and bathroom even smaller, but this has to be the greatest boutique hotel in Jakarta - you get 5-star service and comfort in a small package. Popular among locals for weddings, and really interesting to see guests in their traditional Javanese attire. Lots of dining choices, and it's the type of location where a foreigner can enjoy walking around and being in a relatively quiet and cosy part of Jakarta.
